android.extraProguardRules:
# --- Kavach Tier-0 keep rules (ADR-015) -----------------------------------
# R8 only runs on release builds, so whatever it strips is missing from the
# one build users actually install. A stripped T0 class does not crash: the
# OS simply never delivers LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED or ACTION_SHUTDOWN to a
# class that is not there, so the emergency plane is silently absent. That
# is the exact failure mode P-035 and P-022 exist to prevent, and no smoke
# test would catch it. Certainty here costs a few KB of dex.
#
# modules/kavach-t0/android/build.gradle ships no consumerProguardFiles on
# purpose, so the T0 classes reach R8 with no rules of their own. The four
# components named in AndroidManifest.xml (KavachForegroundService,
# BootReceiver, ShutdownReceiver, KavachDeviceAdminReceiver) are keep roots
# via the merged manifest -- but that roots the CLASS, not its members, and
# KavachT0Module is not in the manifest at all: it is reached only through
# the generated ExpoModulesPackageList. Keep the whole package.
-keep class expo.modules.kavacht0.** { *; }

# Records are populated purely by reflection: RecordTypeConverter locates
# @Field via kotlin.reflect findAnnotation(), then writes each value with
# javaField.set() keyed on the Kotlin PROPERTY NAME. A renamed field does
# not throw -- the value is dropped and the property keeps its default. On
# ForegroundAgentOptions that silently discards the P-035 pre-unlock
# payload (emergencyNumbers, peerFingerprints, guardianReleaseTokenSha256),
# leaving T0 booted and configured with nothing. expo-modules-core ships
# the 'implements' twin of this rule; keeping our own copy means a
# dependency bump that drops its consumerProguardFiles cannot quietly take
# the emergency plane with it.
-keep class * extends expo.modules.kotlin.records.Record { *; }

# The reflection above needs the metadata that carries it: @Field is
# @Retention(RUNTIME), kotlin-reflect (pulled in by expo-modules-core)
# resolves properties through @kotlin.Metadata, and Signature is what
# preserves the element type of the List<String> fields on
# ForegroundAgentOptions -- without it they arrive as a raw List and no
# element converter can be chosen. R8 full mode is the AGP 8 default, so
# none of this is inherited by accident; state it explicitly.
-keepattributes RuntimeVisibleAnnotations,AnnotationDefault,Signature,InnerClasses,EnclosingMethod
-keep class kotlin.Metadata { *; }
